title: Senior Staff Engineer, Big Data Infrastructure
description: Who we are About Stripe Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies - from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career. About the team In this role, you’d be joining the Big Data Infrastructure team. Our team builds and maintains the platforms that power data work across Stripe, managing three core layers: Data Orchestration (Airflow) Batch Compute (Spark, Celeborn) Data Lake (Iceberg, Hive, S3, Azure Blob Storage) We support over 2,000 engineers and 600+ internal teams, processing workloads that organically grow more than 30% year over year. Our infrastructure handles massive scale, managing over 800 PB of data, running 325,000 applications a day, and accounting for hundreds of millions of dollars in annual spend, directly powering critical pipelines like inbound payments, network reconciliation, and capital underwriting. What you’ll do As the technical leader for the Big Data Infrastructure organization, you will guide a 40+ person engineering team to scale our foundational data systems. You will partner closely with major internal customers like Data Foundations, Payins Engineering, and AI/ML Foundations to modernize our tech stack and execute Stripe's transition to the "Agentic Era" - building "invisible infrastructure" where AI agents operate data pipelines end-to-end. Responsibilities Serve as the technical leader for the Big Data Infrastructure organization, overseeing distributed systems that manage 20% of Stripe's total AWS spend Execute Stripe's transition to the "Agentic Era" by building invisible infrastructure that empowers AI agents to author, validate, ship, and operate data pipelines Drive the architecture and delivery of critical modernization bets, including YARN to Kubernetes migrations, native vectorization (Gluten/Velox), and Airflow and Data Catalog modernization Lead the implementation of a multi-region and multi-cloud data strategy for high availability, disaster recovery, and Azure Blob Storage compliance Reduce operational burden and maintenance overhead (KTLO) from over 40% to under 10% by shifting fixes into the platform instead of relying on runbooks Foster a culture of operational excellence and mentor engineers at various stages in their careers, up to Staff+ Who you are We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement. Minimum requirements BS or MS in Computer Science or a related field This is a Senior Staff role, so ideally 12+ years of professional experience in a software development role A strong engineering background in distributed infrastructure and/or platform services, including one or more of the following: storage, databases, or compute Experience leading projects on a cross-team and company-wide scale, including scaling and migrating systems with little to no downtime Experience developing, maintaining, and debugging distributed systems while optimizing their reliability and security Experience driving a culture of operational excellence, with a deep understanding of metrics, alerts, and dashboards Preferred qualifications Experience driving AI-led architectural transformations and integrating agentic workflows into large-scale data systems Experience in a development team at AWS, Azure, OCI, or Google Experience with big data infrastructure at scale, such as Spark, Iceberg, S3, Airflow, YARN, and Celeborn Experience with database internals and/or with Kubernetes
